description: gzapp's GZCoord integration: the Claude-Bridge relay hosted on the coordinator's workspace, the channel every gzapp agent joins, where a gzapp working copy keeps the relay token, and where the hosted relay's runtime lives. Read by gzcoord-inbox when the working copy resolves to project gzapp; CLAUDE_BRIDGE_URL and GZCOORD_CHANNEL in the environment override it. token_env_file is relative to the working copy; relay_runtime_dir is relative to the workspace (the projects/ directory holding the fabric checkout), never inside a repository.
